_about: The single-attack-button combo (docs/pivot/kh_combo_design.md). One press asks 'what is the next move?' and the rules below answer from the situation. Rules are checked top to bottom inside the matching 'from'; the first whose 'when' is true wins. Moves are the ones in moves.json (set 'red'). Numbers are starting guesses for Ross to tune. ComboSelector (scripts/combat/model/combo_selector.gd) reads the rules and ActionPlayer asks it on every attack press; the hack button's call-out text is read from buttons.hack.

attack.note: the one attack button (J, left mouse, X or Square). Heavy-button presses no longer start Red's Heavy, Launcher or any attack.

hack.note: K, right mouse, Y or Triangle. Reserved for Red's hacker abilities. For now it only shows the call-out.

params._params: near_radius_m: enemies this close to Red count as 'near' (5 m = a Grunt's whole circling ring). far_dist_m: further than this from the target counts as 'far'. string_timeout_ms: after a move ends with no press, the string forgets itself. short/long_string_hits: the hit number at which a finisher comes (3 normally, 5 against a guarding or armored target). finishers: moves that end a string.

conditions.target_dist_m: [min, max] metres from Red to the current target (lock-on target, else the best target in front)
conditions.target_exists: true/false: any target in front within lunge_max_dist_m
conditions.target_airborne: the target is off the ground (launched or juggled)
conditions.target_launchable: the target can be launched (enemies.json launchable)
conditions.target_guarding: the target is armored or its guard is up
conditions.enemies_near_min: at least this many living enemies within near_radius_m of Red
conditions.string_pos: [min, max] how many attack hits this string has started, counting the move that just played
conditions.last_hit_connected: the move that just played hit something

rules.why: Pressing in the air starts the air string.
An enemy is in the air: Red jumps up to it and attacks (the existing follow-jump).
A target beyond Light 1's reach (2 m) and within the lunge's 8 m: close the gap with a lunge. It counts as hit 1.
A lunge counts as hit 1, so the string continues with Light 2.
Fifth hit of a long string: the slam finisher (breaks a guard).
Three or more enemies close: the spin finisher hits them all.
A guarding or armored target: keep chipping, the long string ends in the slam.
Cannot be launched: go for the slam at hit 5 instead.
A normal target: the string ends by launching it.
The target is in the air: Red follows it up (the existing follow-jump).
The air finisher slams the target down.
End of the air string; the next press starts fresh when Red lands or after the timeout.

cancel_windows.rule: A press is accepted from the playing move's cancels.chain[0] to chain[1] in moves.json, and a press made earlier waits in the buffer and fires exactly at chain[0] (the existing behaviour). A press inside the window of a move with no chain window (launcher, air_3) is buffered until the move ends.
cancel_windows.dash_cancel: Dash, jump and parry cancels stay as written in moves.json.
cancel_windows.restart: A rule marked 'restart' sets string_pos back to 0 after the move, so the next press starts a new string.

string_shapes._about: What the rules above produce, for reading. Hit numbers in brackets.
string_shapes.normal_ground: Light 1 (1), Light 2 (2), Light 3 (3), Launcher (4), then Air 1 (5), Air 2 (6), Air 3 (7).
string_shapes.guarding_or_armored: Light 1, Light 2, Light 3, Light 1, Light 2, Heavy slam (6).
